title: 第44章 初展神技第45章 同行解惑
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
赵宇一人独行向前，突然听到后边传来一阵阵车马之声，赵宇转身一看，后边一大队人马不徐不急地驶了过来，好像是一帮人押运着许多货物，是商队、还是镖队，或是家族中人就不得而知了。
赵宇让到路边，好让车队通过，他很想上前和他们搭讪一下，主要想问问附近有何大一些城镇。
当时南宫秋月给他的地图只是有关浮云山脉的。
但他毕竟刚刚出道，还是有些不好意思，到底上不上前询问又纠结又有犹豫。
这一队人马大约有二十多人，领头两人身材高大、霸气十足，看来当领头人是需要一些威慑力的。
赵宇对这队人仔细辩识一下，这些人最高境界不过是脱俗境五重。
在武修世界中所谓的境界修为绝不是让人一眼就能看清楚的，这不是商品买卖要吊牌说明。
只是那些境界修为相对较高的武者，特别是神魂相对强大的武者，就可以比较容易辨认境界修为相对较低的武者。
但也有很多的不确定性，例如有些法术可遮住自身的修为，也可以用符箓之法来隐藏，还有用一些特殊的法宝等等。
至于脱俗境在凡武大陆大摡处于什么段位，赵宇问过南宫秋月，南宫秋月告诉他属于中间段位。
而对现在的赵宇来说，脱俗境内已无敌，对低阶超凡境也可轻松解决，只有对超凡境高阶武者才需全力相对。
想到此时，赵宇内心大为感概，想不到自己从浮云山脉转一圈，而变成了小高手！
那一队车马徐徐而来，刚看到赵宇时，还做了一些戒备，但一看赵宇就孤身一人，又如此年轻，便放下戒备之心，也没太在意赵宇，看了看也没打招呼，车队从赵宇面前一一通过。
这一队人，有十二辆马车，其中十辆都装满了货物，而马车上的货物赵宇用鼻子一辩就知道都是药材，在后面的两辆车一看就是坐人的。
就在那帮马队快要从赵宇面前全部通过时，后边的两辆马车突然停了下来，从马车上下来一个中年男子，那中年男子走向赵宇，对赵宇微微一抱掌开口道：“这位公子，是否是在浮云山中历练而来？”
赵宇有些惊讶，想不到车上下来之人还挺有礼数，既然别人有礼，自己也不能失了礼，惊讶之余便回过神来，也对那中年男子回施一礼，道：“这位大叔，有礼了，确实我前此日子一直在浮云山中历练，但出山时走错了道，现在有些迷路了，正想询问则个，有劳了。”
这位中年男子倒也爽快，摆了摆手：“不碍事，公子能否告知一下名讳？噢，我是蔡家人，蔡白。”
蔡家人！
赵宇听完身体微微一震，怎么这么巧！
自己刚出山就碰到蔡姓之人，这人难不成和蔡中和前辈有关联？不过应该不是，只是同姓而已，因为蔡中和说得很清楚，家在帝都，而此地与帝却相距不知有多远。

此时和蔡姓之人相遇不过是巧合罢了，不过还真有缘分！
赵宇一听是蔡姓之人，就有一种天然的好感，一脸的兴奋之色溢于言表，忙回答道：“大叔你好，我叫赵宇。”
蔡白一看赵宇的样子，俊白秀美，淡然优雅，就认定赵宇是大族公子。
年纪轻轻还很有礼貌，也同样大为好感。
开始时，他下来和赵宇打招呼，还是听从了车辆里的自家公子的指使。
这就是俗世中所称的眼缘。
既然内心相喜，说话就变得相对简单，蔡白用手指了指那辆马车，说道：“公子既然迷路了，不如和我等同行吧，我们这次到浮云山也是采购一些货物，正好回城，不知公子意下如何？”
赵宇一听当然大为高兴，简直瞌睡来了送枕头。
便对蔡白感谢道：“那就多谢大叔了，大叔以后也别称我公子了，就叫我赵宇即可。”
随后，赵宇跟着蔡白来到最后边的那辆马车上，蔡白和赵宇一同上了车，然后指了指前面那辆马车道：“那是，那是我家公子所剩之车，公子平时素来喜静，所以我们就不去打搅了。”
赵宇点头，就和蔡白一起坐到车辆之上。
content_en:
Zhao Yu was walking forward alone when he suddenly heard the sound of carriages and horses coming from behind. Zhao Yu turned around and saw a large group of people driving over slowly and unhurriedly. It seemed that they were a group of people escorting a lot of goods. It was unclear whether they were a caravan, an escort team, or members of the family.
Zhao Yu stepped aside to let the convoy pass. He wanted to go up and strike up a conversation with them. He mainly wanted to ask about any larger towns nearby.
At that time, the map Nangong Qiuyue gave him was only about the Fuyun Mountains.
But after all, he had just debuted, so he was still a little embarrassed. He was confused and hesitant about whether to go forward and ask.
There are about twenty people in this team. The two leaders are tall and domineering. It seems that being the leader requires some intimidation.
Zhao Yu carefully identified this group of people and found that the highest level of these people was only the fifth level of the realm of transcendence.
In the world of martial arts, the so-called realm of cultivation is by no means something that can be seen clearly at a glance. This is not something that needs to be explained by a tag when buying and selling goods.
Only those warriors with relatively high realms of cultivation, especially those with relatively powerful souls, can more easily identify warriors with relatively low realms of cultivation.
But there are also a lot of uncertainties. For example, some spells can cover one's own cultivation, you can also use talismans to hide it, and you can also use some special magic weapons, etc.
As for the rank of the Refined Realm in Daquan of the Martial Continent, Zhao Yu asked Nangong Qiuyue, and Nangong Qiuyue told him that it belonged to the middle rank.
For Zhao Yu now, he is invincible in the realm of transcendence, and he can easily deal with low-level transcendent realms. Only high-level warriors in the transcendent realm need to fight with all his strength.
Thinking of this, Zhao Yu was greatly moved. He never imagined that he would turn around from the Fuyun Mountains and become a little master!
The team of cars and horses came slowly. When they first saw Zhao Yu, they were on guard. But when they saw that Zhao Yu was alone and so young, they put down their guard and didn't pay much attention to Zhao Yu. They looked at him without saying hello. The motorcade passed in front of Zhao Yu one by one.
There were twelve carriages in this group, ten of which were filled with goods. Zhao Yu could tell with his nose that the goods on the carriages were all medicinal materials. The two carriages at the back were for people.
Just when the horse team was about to pass in front of Zhao Yu, the two carriages behind suddenly stopped, and a middle-aged man got out of the carriage. The middle-aged man walked towards Zhao Yu, hugged Zhao Yu slightly and said, "Did this young master come from experience in Fuyun Mountain?"
Zhao Yu was a little surprised. He didn't expect that the person who got off the car was quite polite. Since others were polite, he couldn't be rude. After being surprised, he came back to his senses and bowed back to the middle-aged man. He said: "Uncle, you are polite. It is true that I have been practicing in Fuyun Mountain the past few days, but I took the wrong road when I came out of the mountain. Now I am a little lost. I just wanted to ask, thank you."
The middle-aged man was quite cheerful and waved his hand: "It's okay, sir, can you tell me your name? Oh, I am Cai Bai, a member of the Cai family."
Cai family!
Zhao Yu's body trembled slightly after hearing this, what a coincidence!
As soon as he came out of the mountain, he met a person named Cai. Could this person be related to senior Cai Zhonghe? But that's probably not the case, it's just the same surname, because Cai Zhonghe made it very clear that his family is in the imperial capital, but the distance between this place and the emperor is unknown.
It was just a coincidence that I met the person named Cai at this time, but it was really fate!
When Zhao Yu heard that it was someone with the surname Cai, he had a natural affection. His face was filled with excitement, and he hurriedly replied: "Hello, uncle, my name is Zhao Yu."
When Cai Bai saw Zhao Yu's appearance, he was handsome, handsome, calm and elegant, he decided that Zhao Yu was a rich man.
He was very polite even though he was young, and he was also very fond of him.
At first, he came down to greet Zhao Yu, but he still followed the instructions of his young master in the vehicle.
This is what is called in the secular world.
Since the inner feelingsHi, speaking became relatively simple. Cai Bai pointed at the carriage and said: "Since the young master is lost, why not come with me? We are also going to Fuyun Mountain to purchase some goods this time, and we are just returning to the city. What do you think of the young master?"
Zhao Yu was of course very happy when he heard this. He almost felt sleepy and gave him a pillow.
Then he thanked Cai Bai and said, "Thank you very much, uncle. From now on, uncle, don't call me young master. Just call me Zhao Yu."
Later, Zhao Yu followed Cai Bai to the carriage at the end. Cai Bai and Zhao Yu got on the carriage together, and then pointed to the carriage lane in front: "That is, that is the remaining carriage of my young master. The young master usually likes to be quiet, so we won't disturb him."
Zhao Yu nodded and sat on the vehicle with Cai Bai.
